title: L'Occitane Group to offload Elemis to PAI Partners
summary: L'Occitane is selling British skincare brand Elemis, a premium British skincare brand established in 1989, to French private equity firm PAI Partners, which plans to accelerate the brand's growth in the United States, both companies announced on November 4. The transaction, the financial terms of which have not been disclosed, is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027, subject to customary regulatory approvals, according to a press release.
